_doc: Config for expansion 3.3 (low-relief slope stratification, then edits). Path specs resolve through expkit (path_for / area_dir / exp_dir). Items marked assumed are not held yet; the scripts fail with a message naming them.
_footprint_note: User confirmed the all-block footprint on 2026-11-06 (take defaults). The 29 pit-free blocks are scored, as targets are.
_margin_note: User accepted the default 0.03 recall on 2026-11-06 (take defaults). Loss in recall points that would change the decision to try a flat county. Change freely.
_proposal_note: Review F02. Primary is ek.policy_for('pit') (0.35 in every fold, which equals the archival leave-one-fold-out cutoff). loo_max_recall and fixed (proposal_thr 0.10, the fw_00 sensitivity) are sensitivities only. Changed 2026-11-06.

audit_blocks.schema: P2 audit CSV with # header and sha256 sidecar, read with ek.require_audit / ek.read_audit

derived_buffer.from: P1 S4 derived buffer (receptive field plus patch support plus correlogram range)

isolated_fold_blocks.schema: P1 split CSV block_id,fold,role, read with ek.read_split_csv (roles train/inner_val/held_out)

isolated_pit_ckpt.from: P1 isolated pit trainer (not built yet)
isolated_pit_ckpt.schema: torch checkpoint with keys state_dict, channels, mu, sd, epoch (same as data/9t/models/pit/unet_cv5/fold*/best.pt)

multiplicity._note: User default 2026-11-06. Holm over declared primary gates. Only the feature-level slope difference is gated, so the family has one member and Holm equals the unadjusted gate. Q2 edits have no margin and are reported. Relief and block-level rows are secondaries, never gated.
